description: This file defines the CatalogItemService class in C#, implementing operations to create, read, update, delete, and list catalog items via HTTP requests, and enriching items with brand and type names using external lookup services.

classes.name: CatalogItemService
classes.description: A service class to manage catalog items, providing create, edit, delete, get, and list operations, with support for asynchronous HTTP communication and data enrichment.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item via an HTTP POST request.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Updates an existing catalog item via an HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID via an HTTP DELETE request.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by ID, including brand and type names.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items with associated brand and type names, with logging.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves an unpaged list of catalog items with associated brand and type names, with logging.
